text:
Type: tall glass-door display cabinet
Use: displaying dishes, glassware, books and collections; dining room, living room
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: solid wood with a white stain that shows the grain, clear glass door panes, dark metal knobs
Colors: soft white, clear glass, dark grey knobs
Shape: tall upright cabinet with two full-height framed glass doors split by a mid rail, inner shelves, small round knobs, flat top, short square legs, stately, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, homey, classic, airy
Goes with: light wood floors, linen textiles, blue or grey walls; farmhouse, country or Scandinavian dining rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Solid wood has a natural feel.
